proposals.before: You Wudao Rong was from Langye.
proposals.reason: The Chinese surname/given-name sequence 由吾道榮 is Youwu Daorong, not You Wudao Rong.

proposals.before: You Wudao Rong was a native of Langye.
proposals.after: Youwu Daorong was a native of Langye.
proposals.reason: The literal translation should preserve the correct name segmentation 由吾道榮 as Youwu Daorong.

proposals.before: He bound his son and offered him as hostage, asking to be beheaded himself if he proved wrong.
proposals.after: He bound his son and offered him as a hostage, asking that the son be beheaded if his prediction proved wrong.
proposals.reason: The object of 斬之 is the son offered as hostage, not Wang Chun himself.
解法選 is the personal name Xie Faxuan; the current English incorrectly segments it as Jiefa Xuan.

proposals.before: Jiefa Xuan was a native of Henei.
proposals.after: Xie Faxuan was a native of Henei.
proposals.reason: The literal translation should render 解法選 as Xie Faxuan rather than Jiefa Xuan.

proposals.before: That night Langye’s fifth son urgently summoned Yongluo, claiming an edict.
proposals.after: That night five envoys from the Prince of Langye urgently summoned Yongluo, claiming an edict.
proposals.reason: 琅邪王五使 means five envoys of the Prince of Langye, not the prince's fifth son.

proposals.before: That night the fifth son of the Prince of Langye urgently summoned Yongluo, saying it was an edict summons.
proposals.after: That night five envoys of the Prince of Langye urgently summoned Yongluo, saying it was an edict summons.
proposals.reason: 王五使 parses as the prince sent five envoys; it is not a reference to a fifth son.

decisions.reason: s0006 names 由吾道榮: compound surname 由吾 plus given name 道榮, i.e. Youwu Daorong. “You Wudao Rong” mis-segments the name; the proposed English is accurate.
The same unit’s literal must match 由吾道榮 as Youwu Daorong. The original literal inherits the same false segmentation as the idiomatic line.
s0030 遽縛其子詣王為質，不勝請斬之: 之 resumes the son just offered as hostage. The idiomatic wrongly makes Wang Chun himself the one to be beheaded; the proposal restores the correct patient.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 縛其子詣王為質，不勝請斬之

decisions.reason: s0133 names 解法選: surname 解 (Xie) and given name 法選 (Faxuan). “Jiefa Xuan” invents a wrong compound-surname cut; Xie Faxuan is the correct segmentation.
The literal field for the same name must likewise render 解法選 as Xie Faxuan, not Jiefa Xuan.
s0167 琅邪王五使切召永洛: 五使 means five envoys, not a fifth son (which would be 第五子/五子). The original idiomatic invents kinship; the proposal matches the Chinese.
The literal’s “fifth son of the Prince of Langye” likewise misreads 五使. “Five envoys of the Prince of Langye” is the correct parse and natural English.

claimRetractions.reason: Accepted r0001 shows “You Wudao Rong” exists only as a mistranslation of 由吾道榮; the Chinese supports Youwu Daorong (c0019), not this alternate English segmentation.
Accepted r0004 shows “Jiefa Xuan” was created only by mis-segmenting 解法選; the Chinese supports Xie Faxuan (c0140), not this alternate form.
